stories.title: New courtyard takes shape on Pandora, amid chronic street disorder
stories.summary: The outdoor plaza is designed to bring more shows and people to Royal Conservatory of Music venues hampered for years by street camping in the area.

stories.title: B.C. Transit warns rolling strike could hit Victoria on Tuesday
stories.summary: Bus riders are being warned to expect service disruptions if the union escalates labour action.

stories.title: Carney meets with President Xi in Shenzhen, China ahead of APEC summit
stories.summary: SHENZHEN — Prime Minister Mark Carney and Chinese President Xi Jinping held a bilateral meeting in the metropolis of Shenzhen as Carney seeks to expand trade with China on everything from agriculture and energy to financial services and automobiles.

stories.title: Surveillance pricing could lead to more expensive groceries for some, MPs hear
stories.summary: OTTAWA — People with religious or health-based food restrictions could end up paying more for groceries with the use of algorithmic pricing, an expert told MPs at a parliamentary committee Monday.

stories.title: Liberals' 'lawful access' bill vulnerable to constitutional challenge: professor
stories.summary: OTTAWA — A law professor says a Liberal government bill that would make it easier for police and spies to navigate the online world could be found unconstitutional due to a provision on retaining metadata.

stories.title: PGA Tour makes changes to feeder system as it wraps up work on new competition model
stories.summary: The PGA Tour is doing away with the PGA Tour Americas in 2028 as it moves to create a vast network of feeder tournaments throughout the year that will have one ranking system to reward players trying to make it to the big leagues.

stories.title: Several staffers leaving Poilievre's office weeks after B.C. election
stories.summary: OTTAWA — Five staff members are leaving the office of Opposition Conservative Leader Pierre Poilievre, including his deputy chief of staff and two of his senior communications aides.
